description: Use when advising on CMS Hospital Star Rating strategy or benchmarking a hospital quality performance trajectory. Returns domain weights, national distribution benchmarks, and improvement priorities. Example: Mortality domain weighted at 22% of overall star — hospitals moving 3 to 4 stars typically require 18-month mortality improvement program — 3-star hospitals represent 41% of the national distribution. Source: CMS Care Compare methodology. $0.02 USDC per call.
